يبتهج (form VIII)
# يَبْتَهِجُ (yabtahiju) /jab.ta.hi.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# يُبْتَهَجُ (yubtahaju) /jub.ta.ha.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# يَبْتَهِجَ (yabtahija) /jab.ta.hi.d͡ʒa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
